edits.text:
- `/cameras/colombia/medellin/` Beats Argos by: lists every camera of the city's own SIMM (traffic control centre) CCTV point list that has a picture address as a named link to that address, named as the city names it (a place and a street corner, for example El Castillo (Cr 83C Cl 33)), with the CC BY SA catalogue licence and the ShareAlike credit printed, the licence record re-read by our importer before every run, the 11 of 81 points with no picture address left out and said so, and an honest unknown status instead of a guessed live or dead.
  - Helpful: a driver or resident sees every Medellín traffic-control camera by place and street corner with a link to the city's own picture. Gain: a licence read in code before every import, the dropped points counted on the page, no invented status. HCU: one real list, one source, no padding, pictures not copied.
